prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated 2D fighting-game scenery prop, transparent PNG cutout, to be layered over the supplied stage reference. Reference image is ONLY for palette, line work, light direction and architecture. Do not reproduce its buildings, floor or sky. Clean hand-drawn 2D animation background art, precise dark contour lines, rich flat/cel shading, game production quality. One coherent object only, entirely visible with modest transparent margin on every side. Native alpha transparency outside object and through open cutouts. No cast shadow plane, no ground, no frame, no labels, no words, no characters, no collage, no contact sheet. This is a new AU game adaptation prop and must not pretend to be a screenshot of the show. Create a complete ornate flower seller's pushcart for the Cannibal Town square. A compact antique burgundy and ivory wooden pushcart with two large thin iron spoked wheels, long push handles, pale brass scrollwork, several lush bunches of crimson and pale cream roses with dark desaturated leaves, all attached in one cart. No canopy, no text. Full object in restrained three-quarter side view suitable for right-side middle depth scenery in a horizontal arena, wheels on a level baseline. Match the warm maroon Victorian palette and painterly detail of the reference. Landscape 3:2 composition, centered object, transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE separate scenery prop for a 2D fighting-game foreground over the supplied Hazbin Hotel exterior. The supplied reference is ONLY for line work, materials, palette and motifs. Output only the object described below, not a background or a screenshot. Precisely match the reference's clean hand-drawn 2D television animation look, strong dark maroon outlines, restrained flat cel shading, burgundy crimson and pale warm gold palette; no painterly realism, no stone texture noise. Entire object visible with modest margin. Native alpha transparency outside the object and in all cutouts. One object, no characters, no text, no montage, no floor, no contact shadow plane, no wall or building. Create one short decorative entrance planter matching this original season-one Hazbin Hotel forecourt. A compact red-burgundy angular trapezoid planter on a shallow pedestal, thin pale-gold edge trim and one small stylized golden eye-shaped decorative inset; holds one dense bush of dark plum pointed leaves and a handful of crimson roses. Its base is flat, front elevation with only slight top view, strong simple cartoon shapes. This is an AU game prop, not a copied episode object. Portrait composition, transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single wide 16:9 2D fighting game stage background, fully opaque, no characters. References are two official Prime Video Hazbin Hotel season-one trailer storyboard images. Use ONLY the building in the BOTTOM RIGHT frame of reference 1 (trailer 00:16) and the TOP LEFT frame of reference 2 (00:18) as the actual architectural reference; all other storyboard panels, characters, captions and storyboards are irrelevant and must not appear. Create a wide front-entrance arena of the ORIGINAL season-one Hazbin Hotel before its destruction. Preserve the recognizable maroon/red asymmetrical hotel architecture, warm pale-gold trim, dark narrow arches and windows, the central entrance with its tall red gold-framed VACANCY arch and eye motif, black-and-cream triangular decorative frieze, rooftop red-bulb HAZBIN HOTEL sign and crooked radio structure. It must look like the Hazbin Hotel shown by the official frames, never a generic cathedral, never a human Victorian hotel or Scarlet Cabaret. Hand-drawn 2D animation style with clean strong dark outlines and controlled flat cel-shaded colors matching the show, no photorealism, no 3D. Composition: level side-on fighting-game camera across the forecourt; long continuous unobstructed horizontal red-brown paved fighting lane spans the bottom 30% of the image, hotel façade and its steps occupy middle distance, infernal crimson sky and distant Pentagram city at edges. The broad front combat lane is the deliberate gameplay adaptation; keep architectural motifs faithful to the references. No pedestrians, no people, no characters, no vehicles, no statues of characters, no detached foreground props. Text allowed only on actual building signs: 'HAZBIN HOTEL' and 'VACANCY'. No caption, no subtitles, no trailer UI, no extra branding, no watermark. ONE completed arena image filling a wide landscape canvas, not a grid or montage.
